name: Strategy
overview: Scripture reveals that godly strategy involves careful planning and wise division of forces in times of conflict, as demonstrated by Abram’s preparation and pursuit of his enemies (Genesis 14:14-15) and Jacob’s prudent division of his people to preserve life (Genesis 32:7-8). Joshua and Gideon further exemplify strategic action by selecting valiant men and organizing them thoughtfully to achieve victory (Joshua 8:3; Judges 7:16). These examples show that effective strategy, under God’s guidance, combines courage, discernment, and order to accomplish His purposes in difficult circumstances.
